checks.scientific_design: No substantive statistical blocker found in the frozen scientific values. Three schedules over two datasets and12 seed units yield72 final models. All arms use the same two-fit continuation mechanism, preventing continuation itself from being unique to stepup/down arms. Contrast concerns complete schedule regimes, not an isolated instantaneous jump with identical prehistory.

Cumulative LR clock includes zero at t0 and assigns rates to the correct tree segments. It is a descriptive prescribed clock, not a guarantee of equal gradient paths or partitions.

Two-sided Student-t intervals with per-comparison alpha=.05/4 have nominal Bonferroni family coverage under the stated approximation.
